settings.ggU7kZp_UF4_childItem_0: How does the click trainer actually work?
settings.ggYzEOathXK_text: The Pro Swing Click Trainer is a standalone training aid, not a club — you swing it in place of your club during practice. It works for drivers, irons, and short game. Practice with it before a round or at home in your garden.
settings.ggcx7tsDpjH_text: The trainer uses a spring-loaded mechanism that stays contracted at rest. When you swing through with the correct lag and release timing, the spring extends and produces an audible click. If you release too early, there's no click — giving you instant, honest feedback every single rep.
settings.ggpz5A2eo3e_text: Yes — the trainer is symmetrical and works equally well for left- and right-handed golfers. The grip and spring mechanism function the same way regardless of your dominant hand.
